race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
race.verdict: SAXOPHONIC is fast developing into a course specialist and looks primed to follow up his recent C&D win, with a 4 lb rise offset by the booking of an apprentice who knows him well. Havachoc should again be in the mix after bouncing back behind the selection last time, with Tiger Beetle respected back up in trip after scoring here last month. SAXOPHONIC HAVACHOC TIGER BEETLE
race.bettingForecast: Saxophonic (13/8), Kathleen Mary (4/1), It's A Love Thing (5/1), Havachoc (8/1), Heart Sign (10/1), Man Of Desert (12/1), Tiger Beetle (16/1), The Bay Warrior (20/1), Sea Of Charm (25/1), Rogue Sea (33/1), Hellion (33/1)
